name: Do I need to turn off the main water supply for a toilet replacement?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to turn off the main water supply for a toilet replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, turning off the main water supply to your home is a necessary preparation step for a toilet replacement if the shut-off valve behind the toilet is faulty or non-existent. While most toilets have a dedicated shut-off valve, older homes, especially in areas like Paradise or Summerlin, sometimes have valves that don't fully close. We always check the local shut-off first, but being aware of your home's main water valve location is always helpful.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you may need to turn off the main water supply if the toilet's individual shut-off valve is faulty or missing. This is a common preparation step.
